fixedPoint: The source data/durability failure target remains the actual final store-directory sync before owner authority is removed.

mutex.lifetime: Permanent stable inode; never unlink, replace or recreate as routine lock release.

expectedAuthority.nonce: Exact manager manifest nonce; bound to actual source epoch.

mutex.independentNativeProbe: Open the actual permanent coordination.lock through a separate native handle/process and attempt a nonblocking native exclusive lock. Denial must be the documented lock-contention result; other errors do not prove ownership.
mutex.requiredOrdering: Hold this native mutex through all source/manifest/intent writes, final potentially failing data sync and temporary owner operation.lock cleanup. The permanent mutex is released only after these steps.

ownerAuthority.binding: Keep the exact prepared archive-operation/1 nonce/token from actual intent. This is the owner-bound persistent guard checked after data-sync failure.
ownerAuthority.removal: Owner record may be removed only while the permanent OS mutex is still held. No previous owner may later unlink a mutex pathname used by another actor.

postCommitNativeReleaseBoundary.scope: Only after all data/source/intent operations and successful final data synchronization plus temporary owner removal are complete.
postCommitNativeReleaseBoundary.liveRequirement: If native unlock/close itself reports an error, poison the live instance and attempt bounded diagnostic persistence.
postCommitNativeReleaseBoundary.crossProcessLimit: If every subsequent diagnostic IO also fails, a fresh process cannot necessarily observe a purely native post-commit release exception. No unconditional cross-process failed marker is claimed for that boundary.
doesNotApplyTo: Any source or manifest write, archive/segment deletion, prune intent preparation or cleanup failure.
Any owner cleanup failure before data commit.
postCommitNativeReleaseBoundary.plannedIndependentExecution: Not-executed; this boundary is a stated limitation, not a passing test or a waiver for data-sync failures.

twoPreregisteredCasesRemain.protected-final-sync-fails: Owner guard exists and permanent coordination mutex is actually held at injected data-sync IO failure; guard/live poisoned/fresh incomplete all required.
twoPreregisteredCasesRemain.protected-final-sync-and-marker-io-fail: The same data failure plus actual failure-marker IO failure must retain the original owner authority, poison the live instance and leave fresh verification incomplete.

oldR3AbsentLockSyncCase: Inapplicable/not-executed under the new protocol if no post-unlink data sync exists; never counted as passed. Original r3 actual failures remain unchanged.
